questions.subject: Science & Technology
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements regarding Space Technology (UPSC High-Yield Benchmark Drill #1):
1. It is regulated under statutory guidelines established by the Union framework.
2. The mechanism incorporates quantitative compliance targets evaluated on a multi-tier index.
3. Sovereign immunity applies exclusively under international treaty dispute frameworks.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.detailedExplanation: Comprehensive standard UPSC analysis for Space Technology Drill #1: Statement 1 correctly identifies the regulatory basis. Statement 2 describes the multi-tier quantitative evaluation criteria. Statement 3 reflects standard international and constitutional jurisprudence.
questions.eliminationTechnique: Eliminate extreme modifiers ('exclusively', 'solely') and cross-check institutional nodal jurisdictions.
questions.trapAnalysis: Examiners commonly invert the supervisory authority and inflate numerical timelines.
